<?php
/**
 * SecureMailer - Email sending service with attachment support
 * Version 2.3.1
 */

class SecureMailer {
    private $uploadDir;
    private $allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'doc', 'docx', 'txt', 'png', 'jpg'];
    private $maxFileSize = 5242880; // 5MB
    private $smtpHost;
    private $logFile;

    public function __construct(string $smtpHost, string $uploadBase) {
        $this->smtpHost = $smtpHost;
        $this->uploadDir = rtrim($uploadBase, '/') . '/attachments';
        $this->logFile = rtrim($uploadBase, '/') . '/logs/mailer.log';
        $this->ensureDirectories();
    }

    private function ensureDirectories(): void {
        if (!is_dir($this->uploadDir)) {
            mkdir($this->uploadDir, 0750, true);
        }
        $logDir = dirname($this->logFile);
        if (!is_dir($logDir)) {
            mkdir($logDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    public function handleUploadRequest(array $request, array $files): array {
        $sessionToken = $request['session_token'] ?? '';
        if (!$this->validateSession($sessionToken)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid session', 'code' => 401];
        }

        $recipient = filter_var($request['to'] ?? '', FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL);
        if (!$recipient) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid recipient email', 'code' => 400];
        }

        $subject = $this->sanitizeHeader($request['subject'] ?? 'No Subject');
        $body = htmlspecialchars($request['body'] ?? '', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $attachments = [];
        if (!empty($files['attachments'])) {
            $result = $this->processUploads($files['attachments']);
            if (isset($result['error'])) {
                return $result;
            }
            $attachments = $result['paths'];
        }

        return $this->sendMail($recipient, $subject, $body, $attachments);
    }

    private function processUploads(array $fileData): array {
        $paths = [];
        $fileCount = is_array($fileData['name']) ? count($fileData['name']) : 1;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $fileCount; $i++) {
            $name = is_array($fileData['name']) ? $fileData['name'][$i] : $fileData['name'];
            $tmpName = is_array($fileData['tmp_name']) ? $fileData['tmp_name'][$i] : $fileData['tmp_name'];
            $size = is_array($fileData['size']) ? $fileData['size'][$i] : $fileData['size'];
            $error = is_array($fileData['error']) ? $fileData['error'][$i] : $fileData['error'];

            if ($error !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                continue;
            }

            $validation = $this->validateFile($name, $size, $tmpName);
            if ($validation !== true) {
                return ['error' => $validation, 'code' => 400];
            }

            $safeName = $this->generateSafeFilename($name);
            $destPath = $this->uploadDir . '/' . $safeName;

            if (!move_uploaded_file($tmpName, $destPath)) {
                return ['error' => 'Upload failed', 'code' => 500];
            }

            $paths[] = $destPath;
        }

        return ['paths' => $paths];
    }

    private function validateFile(string $name, int $size, string $tmpPath): mixed {
        if ($size > $this->maxFileSize) {
            return 'File too large: ' . $name;
        }

        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if (!in_array($ext, $this->allowedExtensions, true)) {
            return 'File type not allowed: ' . $ext;
        }

        // Verify MIME type matches extension
        $finfo = new finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mimeType = $finfo->file($tmpPath);
        $allowedMimes = [
            'pdf' => 'application/pdf',
            'doc' => 'application/msword',
            'docx' => 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
            'txt' => 'text/plain',
            'png' => 'image/png',
            'jpg' => 'image/jpeg'
        ];

        if (isset($allowedMimes[$ext]) && $mimeType !== $allowedMimes[$ext]) {
            return 'MIME type mismatch for: ' . $name;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function generateSafeFilename(string $original): string {
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($original, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        $hash = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        return $hash . '.' . $ext;
    }

    private function sanitizeHeader(string $value): string {
        return str_replace(['\r', '\n', '\0'], '', $value);
    }

    private function validateSession(string $token): bool {
        if (empty($token) || strlen($token) < 32) {
            return false;
        }
        // Session validation against store
        return hash_equals($token, hash('sha256', $token . $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? ''));
    }

    private function sendMail(string $to, string $subject, string $body, array $attachments): array {
        $this->log("Sending mail to: $to, subject: $subject, attachments: " . count($attachments));
        // SMTP sending logic would go here
        $this->scheduleCleanup($attachments);
        return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Email queued'];
    }

    private function scheduleCleanup(array $files): void {
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            // Schedule deletion after 1 hour
            touch($file, time() + 3600);
        }
    }

    private function log(string $message): void {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, "[$timestamp] $message\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }

    /**
     * Maintenance endpoint - list pending attachments for cleanup
     * Protected by admin authentication
     */
    public function listPendingFiles(array $request): array {
        if (!$this->isAdminRequest($request)) {
            return ['error' => 'Forbidden', 'code' => 403];
        }

        $subdir = $request['path'] ?? '';
        $targetDir = $this->resolveCleanupPath($subdir);

        if (!is_dir($targetDir)) {
            return ['error' => 'Directory not found', 'code' => 404];
        }

        $files = [];
        $iterator = new DirectoryIterator($targetDir);
        foreach ($iterator as $fileInfo) {
            if ($fileInfo->isDot()) continue;
            $files[] = [
                'name' => $fileInfo->getFilename(),
                'size' => $fileInfo->getSize(),
                'modified' => $fileInfo->getMTime(),
                'path' => $fileInfo->getPathname()
            ];
        }

        return ['files' => $files, 'directory' => $targetDir];
    }

    private function resolveCleanupPath(string $subdir): string {
        if (empty($subdir)) {
            return $this->uploadDir;
        }
        // Normalize path separators and remove dangerous sequences
        $subdir = str_replace('\\', '/', $subdir);
        $subdir = preg_replace('#\.{2,}/#', '', $subdir);
        $resolved = $this->uploadDir . '/' . ltrim($subdir, '/');
        return $resolved;
    }

    private function isAdminRequest(array $request): bool {
        $adminKey = $request['admin_key'] ?? '';
        $expectedKey = getenv('MAILER_ADMIN_KEY') ?: 'default_admin_key_change_me';
        return hash_equals($expectedKey, $adminKey);
    }
}

// Router
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    $mailer = new SecureMailer(
        getenv('SMTP_HOST') ?: 'localhost',
        getenv('UPLOAD_BASE') ?: '/var/www/mailer_data'
    );

    $action = $_GET['action'] ?? 'send';

    switch ($action) {
        case 'send':
            $result = $mailer->handleUploadRequest($_POST, $_FILES);
            break;
        case 'maintenance':
            $result = $mailer->listPendingFiles($_GET);
            break;
        default:
            $result = ['error' => 'Unknown action', 'code' => 400];
    }

    http_response_code($result['code'] ?? 200);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($result);
}
